correctness.rationale: For each a>=34, the exact coin-length recurrence yields ell(n+16)=ell(n)+1 (n>=16) by finite base rows and strong induction. With generator offsets 1,4,9,16, all alternate wraps cost at least as much and the Apéry representatives are w(r)=r+a*ell(r). The PF condition w(r)-a+generator∈S is equivalent to the four displayed coin-length inequalities. Low residues yield only 7,15; interior residues are excluded by the 16-shift identity; terminal residues reduce to 16×16 congruence tests plus monotonic wrap checks at a=34..49. Recalculated the entire table and independent Apéry/Dijkstra PF sets for a=34..90. A=33 has the documented failed member 65+49=114. Thus exact spectrum, type period 16 and stated sharp domain hold; finite checks corroborate the infinite induction rather than replace it.
